functions.does: The rear wheels' 12-long axle runs through the pull-back motor under the back of the car, so the rear wheels roll, turning the motor's axle with them.
functions.source: book: step 33 (page 31, the axle pushed through the motor), steps 59-60 (pages 49-50, wheels)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely on their own 12-long axle; there's no steering.
The pull-back motor: pull the car backwards along the ground and let go, and its spring drives the rear wheels so the car races forward.
functions.source: inferred: what a pull-back motor does; the book shows only the motor and its axle (steps 6-13, pages 8-11, and step 33, page 31)
functions.skip: a spring that only drives under force
